title: Overbought, Still Climbing
briefing: Pebble Games is climbing hard and its RSI is pinned above 70. Tidal Power drifts sideways. Same indicator, two very different markets.
objective: RSI 30/70 works in a range, but a strong trend can stay overbought.
debrief: Pebble Games' RSI sat above 70 for most of the match while the price kept rising; anyone who sold just because it read "overbought" left most of the trend behind. Tidal Power stayed in a range, and its RSI lows after the calm-wind week (day 3) and the slow repairs (day 16) lined up with the bottom of that range. A disciplined player held the trend and used RSI only on the range stock.
